verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Asana publishes an official MCP server (asana-probe-3), meaning Asana exposes its own tools to other MCP clients — but the story asks the reverse: whether a user can plug external MCP servers into Asana so its AI (e.g., AI Teammates/AI Studio) can consume their tools. No evidence pack item describes Asana's AI agents acting as an MCP client or supporting configuration of external MCP servers as tool sources.
